request_evidence.evidence: Article URL: https://bryananthonio.com/blog/straight-line-predicts-how-fast-my-laptop-generates-llm-tokens/ Comments URL: https://news.ycombinator.com/item?id=50507414 Points: 1 # Comments: 0 PRIMARY PAGE: A Straight Line Predicts How Fast My Laptop Generates LLM Tokens Bryan Anthonio About Blog Links Reading A Straight Line Predicts How Fast My Laptop Generates LLM Tokens I went down a rabbit hole to see how memory bandwidth limits the rate at which LLMs generate tokens. November 13th, 2026 10 min read My previous post ended on a cliffhanger. For the model Qwen2.5-0.5B, I found that the time per output token (TPOT) was roughly 9 ms for different prompt sizes. But I didn’t have an explanation for why. I’ve since learned that in the decode phase for large language model (LLM) inference the primary bottleneck is memory bandwidth, the rate at which the GPU reads LLM model weights from RAM. To explore this, I measured the TPOT of six models of varying sizes on my laptop.
